snippet.title: Star Foot 64 [Release + Download]
snippet.description:
Download here: https://github.com/El4rix/Starship/tree/On-Foot

Once reserved just for versus mode, this mod for Star Fox 64's unofficial Starship PC Port lets you play every stage in on-foot mode, whether on-rails, in space, above water, or below!

As featured in Kaze's F3 fangame showcase! https://youtu.be/pR7iSxDThXc
Original music by my BRO: https://youtu.be/o9RhRlcTLcA
